Title: Public preview: Monitoring for Ampere Altra Arm–based VMs and AKS clusters

Body.Content:
Azure Monitor now supports Ampere Altra Arm–based Azure Virtual Machines and Azure Kubernetes Service with Arm nodes. You can now:

  • Easily collect the key metrics to track performance for virtual machines using Azure Monitor agent.
  • Manage data collection settings at scale by defining unique, scoped configurations for subsets of machines using data collection rules.
  • Correlate infrastructure issues for your Arm-based Azure virtual machines with VM insights.
  • Monitor your AKS clusters having Arm nodes with container insights.

Learn more: 

Azure Virtual Machines with Ampere Altra Arm–based processors.

Support matrix for Arm-based virtual machines with Azure Monitor agent.
